headline: A Billionaire’s Basquiat Collection Goes Up at Pérez Art Museum Miami
context: Ken Griffin, the hedge fund manager, looks for artworks with a “wow” factor, never mind the number of zeros on the price tag. Ten of his Basquiats are on loan to the Pérez Art Museum Miami.

sources.name: The New York Times
